flags.label: GNN models for materials property prediction
flags.gloss: Claims about GNN models (CGCNN, MEGNet, M3GNet, PNA) for property and free-energy prediction, including IDNN-based free-energy integration methods.

flags.label: Two- and three-body atomic descriptors
flags.gloss: Components for two-body and three-body atomic descriptors (DeepPot-SE, SOAP) used as inputs to machine-learned interatomic potentials.

flags.label: Surface slab generation and surface energy
flags.gloss: Tasks and problems on generating surface slabs/nanoparticles and modeling potential energy surfaces and surface energies, including amorphous materials.
